title: Challenge 6: Grover Oracle for |11⟩
storyScenario: In an unstructured database of 4 items, item |11⟩ contains the winning cryptographic secret. You must design the Phase Oracle that marks this state.
description: Starting with 2 qubits in equal superposition, implement the phase oracle marking |11⟩ with a -1 phase factor without altering other states.

starterCode.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def build_circuit():
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
    qc.h(0)
    qc.h(1)
    # Mark |11>
    qc.cz(0, 1)
    return qc
starterCode.cirq:
import cirq
q = cirq.LineQubit.range(2)
circuit = cirq.Circuit(cirq.H(q[0]), cirq.H(q[1]), cirq.CZ(q[0], q[1]))

editorial.mathematicalProof: Controlled-Z matrix diag(1, 1, 1, -1) applies phase factor e^{iπ} = -1 strictly when both qubits are |1⟩.
editorial.algorithmicAnalysis: Phase inversion is the critical first step of Grover amplitude amplification, followed by inversion about the mean.

hints: A Controlled-Z (CZ) gate flips the phase of |11⟩ only, leaving |00⟩, |01⟩, and |10⟩ positive.
